subject: Phase 100374: Full CLI Confirmed Memory Mutation Surface
verdict_justification: Phase 100374 implements the confirmed memory mutations (`update`, `invalidate`, `discard`, `correct`) over the CLI along with a hardened, TTY-independent confirmation gate and zero-write `--dry-run` blast-radius previews. All exit codes (0/1/2) strictly follow the contract, files stay below the 450-line limit, and tests achieve >95% per-file coverage and 97.95% aggregate coverage with all 303 workspace files meeting the 90% floor. One minor defect was found: test comments in `main_write_tests.rs` explicitly reference the phase number, violating the roadmap isolation rule.
standard: Phase 100374 specification and Acceptance Criteria (AC-100374-01 through 06)
AGENTS.md hard constraints: file size <= 450 lines, per-file coverage >= 90% lines and functions
AGENTS.md and task rules: roadmap isolation (never reference roadmap files or phase numbers in code/comments)
gaps/full-cli.md §5, §7 step 3, §8: exit-code contract (0 ok, 1 operational, 2 usage/refusal) and non-interactive confirm gates
requirement.md §4.9.2 item 2 (identical tool semantics across bindings), FR-21 (discrete vs continuous update rules), FR-30 (exit codes)

requirements.evidence: All four verbs bound to in-process MCP tools; verified via cli_write_mutate_tests.rs (20 unit tests) and live execution against SQLite store.

`clio discard ID --reason R` off-TTY exits 2 with hint naming `--confirm (or --yes)`; verified in unit test `discard_off_tty_without_confirm_refuses_and_writes_nothing` and end-to-end test `discard_without_confirm_exits_two_end_to_end`.
`--dry-run` emits WriteCall::Preview describing target, bank scope, and irreversibility note with zero writes; verified by `stats` item count assertions before/after.
`clio discard` sets `discarded_at` and `discard_reason` while preserving the item row (`items_total: 1, items_discarded: 1, items_active: 0`), never invoking `erase_request` or destroying DEKs.
442 passed unit tests in clio; workspace `make coverage` passes checking 303 files (TOTAL lines 97.95%, functions 98.92%, 0 files below 90% floor).
Manual, test-backed security review documented in developer log and re-verified during adversarial review (security-bug-finder skill unavailable in environment; documented in §12 Known Limitations).

findings.title: Code comments in test file main_write_tests.rs reference the phase number, violating roadmap isolation
findings.evidence: crates/clio-lib/src/main_write_tests.rs:185 ("// T100374-05 at the binary edge: a non-interactive `discard` with no") and crates/clio-lib/src/main_write_tests.rs:204 ("// T100374-07: `--dry-run` is a zero-write preview and never needs")
findings.requirement_ref: AGENTS.md § Private / Public Boundary / Roadmap isolation; developer task § Hard rules ("never reference private/clio-private/roadmap/, phase numbers, or roadmap files from code or comments")
findings.recommendation: Remove or reword the comments in `crates/clio-lib/src/main_write_tests.rs` to describe the test intent without naming the phase number 100374.

dismissed: Absence of --explain flag on `clio correct`: Dismissed because although the MCP schema for `correct` includes `explain` (due to being grouped under read_defs), `correct` is a mutating command whose CLI signature in gaps/full-cli.md §6 and Phase 100374 §5 Task 1 is specified as `clio correct ID VALUE --reason R`.

Cross-process LocalDevKms missing DEK on `clio correct` following `clio remember`: Dismissed because this is a documented pre-existing limitation of in-memory LocalDevKms across separate process invocations (identical to `clio recall` following `clio remember`); in-process tests prove correct functionality.
